_comment: 2026-10-14 artifact lifecycle for synthetic certification. Incident: the system drive had 4.3 GB free (24.8 GB production DB, ~18,000 leftover test temp databases = ~40 GB) and an ad-hoc cleanup deleted certification-session databases that independent oracles still needed. Policy: (1) every synthetic session RETAINS its database next to its result artifact (evidence follows the verdict); (2) long-running certification scripts refuse to start below minFreeDiskGb; (3) automatic cleanup only ever removes leftovers of the unit-test runner (testArtifactPrefixes) and NEVER anything matching protectedPrefixes or living in a retained-evidence folder.
